messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — FinServCo wants an EU-only POC and wants confirmation there are no US sub-processors handling data in the path. Need quick flags for deal doc.
ajay_se: @maria_sales we can support tenant-level region pinning. short answer: yes for compute and storage if we run in EU region and BYOK KMS; subproc list still has cloud infra in some clouds (see below). Need to confirm which subproc they object to.
olivia_legal: If they require zero US sub-processors at all we need to run Private (VPC) in their tenant and provide subproc attestation. Also need to check data processing addendum. I can start an SCC/SPA request.
kevin_infra: Technical: certs/KMS in eu-west-1 ok. For hosted POC, routing goes through provider X's control plane (subproc). We can route inference traffic to EU-only endpoints and disable cross-region failover with this config:
```
routing_policy:
  mode: tenant_pin
  preferred_region: eu-west-1
  failover: none
```
That avoids sending requests to US compute, but control plane metadata still hits our central control plane in us-central (we can propose private control plane on Dedicated/Private).
customer_corp_cto: Can you confirm if metadata like phone/IP will ever transit US? Their legal team cares about metadata egress too.
ajay_se: Good Q. Control plane metadata (route decisions, billing) currently goes to our region-aware control plane which may be in US for some accounts. For strict EU-only requirement we recommend: Dedicated with Private control plane + BYOK + subproc attestation. I sent the subproc inventory link: https://redwood.internal/subprocessors (DM me if you need access).
redwood-bot: deploy-notice: Config change request queued: routing_policy update for tenant finservco (req-8923)
maria_sales: Thanks team. Olivia — can you draft the attestation checklist? Ajay/Keven — can you prepare one pager (ops impact + pricing delta for Private) for the customer call tomorrow at 11am CET? :pray: 
olivia_legal: On it. I'll add timeline + what we can certify vs recommendations.
kevin_infra: Will add network diagram and 1-line on latency expectations if we lock to eu-west-1.
customer_corp_cto: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If Private is required, what's rough delta to our current quote?
ajay_se: Rough ballpark: Private + BYOK + attestation ~ +25-40% on top of Dedicated POC price. Final number after we size GPUs and standby.
maria_sales: OK scheduling sync with customer post-call. ty all :thumbsup:
